name: LeftoverGPT
description: Turn your leftover ingredients into delicious recipes. LeftoverGPT helps you reduce food waste by generating creative recipes from what you have on hand, with options to order missing ingredients from local stores.

tools.name: generate_recipe_from_ingredients
tools.description: Generates a recipe based on a list of available ingredients. The model will try to use as many of the provided ingredients as possible and suggest common pantry staples if needed.

ingredients.description: List of ingredients the user has available

meal_type.description: Optional meal type (e.g., breakfast, dinner, snack)

cooking_time_limit.description: Optional maximum cooking time in minutes

recipe_id.description: Unique identifier for the generated recipe

missing_ingredients.description: Ingredients needed for the recipe that were not in the input list

commerce_token.description: Secure token required to generate a commerce link for missing ingredients

tools.name: adjust_recipe
tools.description: Modifies an existing recipe based on user feedback (e.g., 'make it spicier', 'swap chicken for tofu').

recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe to adjust

adjustment_request.description: Natural language description of the desired change

recipe_id.description: New ID for the adjusted recipe

tools.name: estimate_recipe_nutrition
tools.description: Provides estimated nutritional information for a generated recipe.

recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe to analyze

tools.name: create_external_grocery_order_link
tools.description: Generates a secure link to order missing ingredients from a third-party grocery provider. Requires a valid commerce_token from generate_recipe_from_ingredients.

commerce_token.description: Security token provided when the recipe was generated

user_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, CA, GB) to select the appropriate provider

checkout_url.description: URL to redirect the user to for checkout

provider_name.description: Name of the fulfillment provider (e.g., Instacart, MealMe)

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the link expires
